defects: Uses `PosMulMono R β` applied with two type arguments, but `PosMulMono` is Mathlib's single-type class for multiplication-monotonicity within one ordered structure (it only takes one type parameter); this is an arity/type error and the class as written does not exist — the intended class was presumably `PosSMulMono R β` (the two-type scalar-action analogue used in gold)

Adds hypothesis `OrderedSemiring R` on the scalar type, which is strictly stronger than gold's minimal `Preorder α`/`Zero α` requirements — gold does not require a full ordered semiring structure on the scalar type

Adds hypothesis `DistribMulAction R β`, which is not required by gold (gold only needs `SMul α β`); this imposes distributivity that is not part of the informal statement or gold's typeclass assumptions
Overall the produced statement is a strictly less general specialization (requiring ring/distributive structure) rather than an equivalent restatement of gold's minimal PosSMulMono-based formulation
